questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer:
The level of the lectures are nice and slow. But the exams are confussing. First of all they are handwritten, so remember to buy a calculator. 
Informations from the exams are very hard to find and the rules changes depending on the exams
